description: Pinned external packaging inputs for ObjcMarkdown. These are fetched into a packaging workspace as needed and are not git submodules of the main repo.

inputs.purpose: Bundle the Adwaita GNUstep theme for Linux/AppImage packaging.
notes: Treat this as a packaging-time workspace dependency, not a source submodule.

danjboyd/plugins-themes-Adwaita carries what the app relies on: the header bar, symbolic icon and segmented-control tinting, and the portal file chooser (121c5cd and later), which Linux uses since libOpenSave was dropped (#43).
aa78037 keeps the overlay scrollbar drawn while its knob is dragged (plugins-themes-Adwaita#47); without it the preview's scrollbar vanished during a drag in Read mode.
2d7862a defines the dimmed label colours (plugins-themes-Adwaita#51); without it secondary text (Preferences notes, the status bar) was black in dark mode.

dd1181a draws controls with libadwaita 1.7's colours (unchecked check boxes and the slider's knob show in dark mode, plugins-themes-Adwaita#55-#61), follows GNOME's Large Text (#53), and prints through GNOME's print dialog via the portal (#52).

589cea6 gives windows tabs: it carries danjboyd/gnustep-window-tabbing (Apple's NSWindow tabbing API) and draws the tab bar as libadwaita's (plugins-themes-Adwaita#63), so documents open as window tabs (#101).

83efd71 (branch markdownviewer-0.2.2-hotfix) is 589cea6 plus only the overlay-scroller fix from e84ab12 (plugins-themes-Adwaita#75): -tile no longer re-enters itself, which overflowed the stack when launching in Split or opening a window tab (#120).
packaging/scripts/stage-linux-runtime.sh fetches and builds this ref; the Linux release workflow adds it to the release notes, and the package records it in metadata/docs/BundledThemes.txt.

inputs.purpose: Preferred Windows GNUstep theme to bundle and default to in MSI packaging when the toolchain can build it coherently.
notes: Current Windows msys2/clang64 build VM is blocked by a libdispatch/CRT mode_t header conflict before this theme can be bundled.
Keep this pinned as an external input rather than a git submodule.

inputs.purpose: Secondary Windows GNUstep theme bundled alongside WinUITheme in MSI packaging.
notes: This private input is optional for ObjcMarkdown MSI release candidates; WinUITheme is the required bundled default.
